title: British Subject Missing - Mr. Watts

page_data.en:
S.I.
Misc. 19/42.
Central
Jan. 9th,
2.

British Subject Missing.
At 10.30a.m. 9-1-42, Chief Inspt. Papp, W.A.S.
Police, conducting enquiries regarding the disappearance
of Mr. Watts, came to the station and requested
assistance to interview Mr. Fraser of the Kailan Mining
Administration.
Assistance was rendered by D.S.I. Cooke. No
further information was obtained.
Pending a clarification of the case, the
Administration will endeavour to retain the services of
Mr. Watts' servants and to appoint a caretaker to look
after the premises.
C.I. Papp passed the following information to the
S.V.P.
Mr. Watts was last seen by a Mrs. Andrews who lives
near the Hungjao Golf Club when he visited her at about
5p.m. 19-12-41.
He is purported to have told Mrs. Andrew that he
was going to Tientsin with T.F. Wei, on Administration
business.
It is known that Mr. Watts did not accompany Wei to
Tientsin.
The chauffeur Yo Dzo Hong, permit No. 28300,
returned to 333 Amherst Avenue during the afternoon of
20-12-41, and left the house a few minutes later.

page_data.zh:
S.I.
杂项 19/42。
中央
1月9日，
2.

英国籍人士失踪。
1942年1月9日上午10时30分，西区警署总督察帕普（Papp, W.A.S.）就瓦茨（Watts）先生失踪一事开展调查，来到本站并请求协助，以便约谈开滦矿务管理局的弗雷泽（Fraser）先生。
副巡官库克（Cooke）提供了协助。未获得进一步信息。
在案件澄清之前，该局将尽力留用瓦茨先生的仆人，并指派一名看守人照管其寓所。
总督察帕普向警务副总长转交了以下信息。
瓦茨先生最后一次被人看见，是住在虹桥高尔夫球场附近的安德鲁斯（Andrews）夫人于1941年12月19日下午5时许拜访她时。
据称，他告诉安德鲁斯夫人，他将因局务与魏特夫（T.F. Wei）一同前往天津。
已知瓦茨先生并未陪同魏氏前往天津。
司机姚佐洪（Yo Dzo Hong），执照号码28300，于1941年12月20日下午返回爱文义路333号，并于数分钟后离开该宅。
